data.long_meaning: Amra (sky) + Pali (jewel). The name Amrapali is derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'sky-jewel'. In Hindu mythology, Amrapali is a legendary courtesan who was enamored by the Buddha and offered him her devotion. The name Amrapali carries the meaning “Sky-jewel” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Amrapali usually hope their child will grow to embody sky-jewel and live with faith, good character and purpose.
